entities.summary: Kieran Donaghy is an Irish Gaelic football and hurling coach and former Gaelic football and basketball player. From Tralee club Austin Stacks, Donaghy played at senior level for the Kerry football team. Donaghy won four All-Ireland Senior Football Championship medals, eight Munster Championships and three National League titles with Kerry, and is the recipient of three All Stars Awards. He announced his retirement from inter-county football on 11 September 2018. Donaghy is also a long-time basketball player, with experience playing for Tralee Warriors in the Irish Super League.
